subject: session_id / process_id in quorum votes
decision: HARD-REQUIRED from revision r28 onward; votes cast before r28 are grandfathered by manifest-anchored identity and are NOT re-signed
why: 4/4 real r27 votes carry neither field; making it hard retroactively would reject the round's own signatures, and re-signing history would rewrite evidence
implementation: verify_quorum.py --strict keeps the hard requirement; the non-strict path records the fields as nullable with provenance; no historical byte changes
consequence: a future vote without either field is refused under both paths once r28 is in force
